name: River Heralds
description: The River Heralds are the ancient merfolk people of Ixalan, famous for elemental magic, who guard the secret of Orazca.

timeline.summary: Azor tasks the merfolk River Heralds with defending the Golden City and the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The merfolk River Heralds were then tasked by Azor to defend the Golden City

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "River Heralds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire abuses the Immortal Sun's power, fracturing its balance with the River Heralds and pushing the empire toward the coasts.
timeline.quote: until its abuse of the artifact’s power fractured that balance

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A prolonged war with the River Heralds causes Azcanta to sink beneath the ocean.
timeline.quote: swallowed by the ocean during a war with the River Heralds

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk crosses the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and pirates.
timeline.quote: crossed the seas in search of the Immortal Sun and the fabled city of gold

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli I uses the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: who had gained possession of the Immortal Sun and used it without restraint

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli is gifted the Immortal Sun and misuses it; the city is ruined and abandoned, and the Sun passes to the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: He wielded the artifact without any wisdom or restraint, and the city was ruined.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, pirates and River Heralds depart; Apatzec Intli III claims the city and declares conquest of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: proclaimed a new age of conquest that would now target Torrezon

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orazca prepares for the Phyrexians and seals itself, but Phyrexian sleeper agents are trapped inside.
timeline.quote: By sealing itself in against exterior threats, the Sun Empire inadvertently trapped itself in with an unknown, terrifying, internal threat

citation.text: "Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The battle of Orazca is fought underground in the sealed city, with tens of thousands killed or turned; the city is reopened by those trapped, letting Huatli's forces in.
timeline.quote: Many tens of thousands of Imperial citizens and River Heralds died or were turned in the opening hours of the battle

citation.text: "Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan joins the party and the vampires talk their way into the Core with Sun Empire soldiers and River Heralds.
timeline.quote: The vampires convinced the party to bring them along into the Core

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli asks Quint's help on Ixalan, where he helps Huatli open the caverns and reanimates Abuelo's spirit before mycoids attack.
timeline.quote: Quint used his magic to reanimate the spirit of a man named Abuelo

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "On Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion hits the River Heralds hard; surviving bands flee to hidden places, most retreating to the Deeproot Tree.
timeline.quote: The New Phyrexian Invasion hit the River Heralds hard, winnowing their already small numbers down.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Heralds defend the Deeproot Tree through a terrible siege; Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa and Vuhana are killed.
timeline.quote: Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa , and Vuhana were killed in the Invasion.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians are driven from the Deeproot Tree, leaving a polluted grave of a swamp.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians would eventually be driven from the sacred site

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' unity shatters and many resort to raids or serve other powers.
timeline.quote: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' fragile unity shattered.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tishana summons all merfolk to a tribal congress, the largest assembly of merfolk bands in Ixalan's history.
timeline.quote: summoned all merfolk who could hear her to the tribal congress so that they could decide together the fate of the plane

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
